issues.issue: The eighth-house thematic preface follows an ornamental divider after LXVI and precedes LXVII; it is not predictive body of prior siege.
The absent person's significator depends on actual relationship to querent; first lord, derived house lord and Moon must not be interchanged.
Fourth/eighth death testimony is explicitly qualified by long absence, remote parts and corroborating intelligence, rather than bare placement.
Derived twelfth from absent person's house is different from the chart's twelfth; strict distinction required.
Sixth-house sickness requires harsh aspect/absence of reception and can be modified by benefic favorable testimony.
Applying adverse aspect predicts illness ahead; separating from evil aspect or combustion is treated as recent escape from danger, not onset.
Lilly explicitly warns that sixth house alone can mean drowsiness, fatigue, bloodletting or preventive medicine, without illness.
A strong favorable significator without eighth-lord affliction is proposed as alive despite earlier malefic square/opposition.
Separate unnumbered absent-return section begins across page seam and must not be omitted from numbered LXVII.
Different journey distances use first, third, fifth, ninth and twelfth houses in distinct conditions; not one indiscriminate survival rule.
Seventh and fourth favor eventual return but with different delays; cadent non-aspecting and cadent-afflicted nonreturn are distinct.
Retrograde significator or Moon-to-retrograde alternative predicts unexpected return, conflicting with simplistic cadent=no return.
Fourth/sixth/eighth/twelfth afflictor rulers are alternative source impediments; eighth case says FEAR death, not independently actual death.
Source return-to-Moon transition crosses original PDF440 and PDF441; early news must not count as physical reunion.
Eighth placement without affliction delays but does NOT prevent return; adverse eighth placement is alleged permanent nonreturn/death.
News/letter near ephemeris day and actual person homecoming are distinct event endpoints, and distance may add fortnight or more.
Time units derived from degrees are selected using real journey length, land/water, signs and houses; no frozen deterministic threshold.
A new unnumbered Querent lifespan section begins on PDF442, not a separate numbered chapter or evidence of a person's lifespan.
First Lord with fortune survives only if benefic does NOT rule eighth; eighth-lord rulership changes polarity despite benefic label.
Mutual versus one-way first/eighth lord reception statements have source-native syntactic ambiguities and apparent reversals; preserve verbatim anchors.
Survival-versus-death timing is conditional on an earlier mortality decision; there are no blind events or actual clinical data.
Eclipse, so-called Anareta, interficient planet and zodiac degrees are historical symbols, not biological mechanisms.
General death timing relies on flexible years/months/weeks units; angular can lengthen rather than accelerate the event.
Fixed signs are described as yielding half years/half months, and this phrasing must not be expanded into a unique modern time formula.
Strong first Lord can supersede afflicted Moon; strong Moon cannot rescue weak first lord in mortality section: source priority is directional.
Spouse comparison explicitly prioritizes nativities, age, birth time and natal transits over a horary figure; never claim full horary-only rule.
Purported climacteric years and malignant fixed stars are historical claims without epidemiological or astronomical parity checks.
The first-versus-seventh spouse mortality comparison crosses pages; role depends on who asked, not automatically man vs woman.
Planetary eighth-house glyphs, Venus/Jupiter gentle death and malefic fever/illness claims are not medicine or reliable causes of death.
Chapter LXVIII begins below horizontal divider; only heading navigation can be included, no wife-property judgments.
No independent full diplomatic second transcription, blind case audit, real absent-person or death outcomes, model runtime test or empirically verified prediction.
